notes.title: Blind Blades Update
notes.content:
Now announcing the first update to Blind Blades! We've specifically addressed several points of feedback from you, our players.

We've dramatically revised the options menu. Set your resolution. Set the music volume. Set the sound effects volume. Turn off that crow!

We've removed the loading dialogue. As a result, a keyboard and mouse should no longer be necessary to play Blind Blades.

Most importantly, your customized controller layouts should now save properly.

No achievements as of yet, but it's on our to do list.
